samples.content:
<translated_code>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>
#include <map>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() {
        bufferPointer = bytesRead = 0;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int ret = 0;
        byte c = read();
        while (c <= ' ') c = read();
        bool neg = (c == '-');
        if (neg) c = read();
        do {
            ret = ret * 10 + c - '0';
        } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
        return neg ? -ret : ret;
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        long long ret = 0;
        byte c = read();
        while (c <= ' ') c = read();
        bool neg = (c == '-');
        if (neg) c = read();
        do {
            ret = ret * 10 + c - '0';
        } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
        return neg ? -ret : ret;
    }
    string next() {
        string sb;
        byte c = read();
        while (c <= ' ') c = read();
        do {
            sb.push_back((char)c);
        } while ((c = read()) > ' ');
        return sb;
    }
private:
    typedef unsigned char byte;
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 16;
    byte buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int bufferPointer, bytesRead;
    byte read() {
        if (bufferPointer == bytesRead) {
            bytesRead = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, stdin);
            if (bytesRead == 0) return -1;
            bufferPointer = 0;
        }
        return buffer[bufferPointer++];
    }
};

class Test {
public:
    Test() : best(LLONG_MAX) {
        memset(cntA, 0, sizeof(cntA));
        memset(cntB, 0, sizeof(cntB));
    }

    void start() {
        R = fr.nextInt();
        C = fr.nextInt();
        int maxN = 2 * (R + C);
        computeBinomial(maxN);
        long long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
        while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
            if (x > y) {
                long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v2][R];
                y += cur * other;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v1][R];
                x += cur * other;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = llabs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        str = fr.next();
        int len = 2 * (R + C);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
        fflush(stdout);
    }

private:
    int R, C;
    vector<vector<long long>> ch;
    int cntA[61], cntB[61];
    long long best;
    string str;
    map<int, map<int, map<long long, long long>>> cache;
    FastReader fr;

    long long cacheGet(int v1, int v2, long long x) {
        auto it1 = cache.find(v1);
        if (it1 == cache.end()) return -1; // sentinel
        auto it2 = it1->second.find(v2);
        if (it2 == it1->second.end()) return -1;
        auto it3 = it2->second.find(x);
        if (it3 == it2->second.end()) return -1;
        return it3->second;
    }

    void cachePut(int v1, int v2, long long x, long long val) {
        cache[v1][v2][x] = val;
    }

    void computeBinomial(int maxN) {
        ch.resize(maxN + 1);
        vector<long long> prev;
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            vector<long long> cur(i + 1);
            cur[0] = cur[i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                cur[j] = prev[j - 1] + prev[j];
            }
            ch[i] = cur;
            prev = cur;
        }
    }

    void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = llabs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
            if (diff < best) best = diff;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = llabs(x - y);
        if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
        long long cached = cacheGet(v1, v2, x);
        if (cached != -1) return cached;
        if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
            if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
                int sum = v1 + v2;
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
            }
            return 0;
        }
        long long ans = 0;
        char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'A') {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        if (c != 'B') {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        cachePut(v1, v2, x, ans);
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    Test te;
    te.start();
    return 0;
}
